info.title: Без имени — Forum API
info.description: FR-01–FR-12. Text-only anonymous forum. Lengths are Unicode characters after trimming (password limit is bytes). Error responses never contain database errors, IP addresses, raw session tokens or author-session IDs. Health endpoint is GET /health outside the API prefix.
